results.name: Four missing definition sets always block operational readiness
Only complete exact authored cases produce reference quantities
Blackout and Replacement have no inferred formula outputs
Required and conditional fields report actionable errors
Non-numeric, negative, non-finite and fractional counts are rejected
Blank cloth cost and explicit zero are distinct
Sell below a cost override blocks staging without inventing a margin policy
E1-style half-up extensions sum integer cents and preserve unknown sources
No-purchase labour and freight remain included in pricing totals
Quantity overrides require reason, fixed units and explicit supported outputs
Source-version changes retain overrides and require new review
Read-only, locked, removed-scope and stale sessions cannot stage
Stale preview and missing acknowledgement prevent any commit
Initial compound staging retains answers, baseline and exact source identities
Manual edit keeps immutable run snapshot and generated baseline
Rerun requires explicit decisions for manual edits and removed parts
Cancel or unresolved diff never mutates the staged configuration
Explicit removal and new generated values apply to the same configuration
Ambiguous stable keys block reconciliation
Failed save preserves answers, decisions and original line state
Lost reply recovery rechecks current authority and never generates twice
Stale totals repair retains lines, run count and original receipt
Draft reset preserves staged history, manual edits and issued fixture
Price-source change and rerun preserve issued snapshot exactly
Export restore validates context, range, override unit, duplicate identities and malformed data
